translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Lasarusa ma menacrina
Na ramoot ianna ma roumbapnan, na mana ia Lasarus, na ma Betani auŋnan. Na Betani auŋa anna Mariaapa mana lacainameac Matana auŋ.
Na an Maria ma Kacootna ormo tabaɨr ruŋkica ndikrina meac, na ma ndona paŋanna lakoar puŋga muririna. Na Lasarus, ma an ramootta roumbapna ramoot, na ma an meacniŋna ndaŋ.
Ri, an meacniŋa Iesusmo kam neaŋga taŋga aindopatna, “Kacoot, an ramootta u matŋirenanna, ma roumbap.”

Na Iesusa anna waraca ma gaindopatna, “An roumbca anna ramootta menacna roumbca wanaiŋ. Anna ma meikramtaɨrmo moca mina Raraŋ Aetaniacna gargara watca manmo i aniac neaŋna. Na an taup mbuŋa Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc toco, ma i aniac aŋgɨnandet.”
Na Iesusa ma Lasarusapa mana mbiniŋmo mamatŋi aniacap.
Na an mɨn mbuŋa, ma Lasarusna roumbna kam mbaracatnanna, ma an auŋa ma eacrinanmo ma kabena ra mbuniŋ mac eacatna.
Karica iŋmbaia ma ndona iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrmo gaindopatna, “Aia Iudiana pitrik waŋga nda taŋna.”
Ri, mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra gaindopatna, “Riripti, rocotta wanaiŋa Iudanaŋgepca unmo watur puŋga rɨŋ menacna morina. Na u an mac taŋna more ki?”

Na Iesusa mina kambmo gainda rutirina, “Ra ma ŋaŋarmuŋa tɨkca taŋi ra wigwac te, ma memetacap. Na u mandaia an kɨdrɨk mbuŋa taŋ te, una ora mba aoclataca irikitndait. Na anna ma gan tiacarpaikna memetac mbuŋa watca taŋrenan.
Na ramootta mouŋa taŋ te, ma irikrenan, an kɨdrɨkca ma memetaca metac watna tac ŋgocor.”
Na ma aindopca maica, iŋmbaia ma gaind mac mbopatna, “Aina aikndamoot Lasarusa ma ŋgorena. Na aku taŋca manmo, mo ŋgepnandet.”
Ri, mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra an kam mbaraca mina gaindopatna, “Kacoot, ma ŋgo te, mana roumbca laŋa moca ma laŋa monande.”
Na mina gaind ndamŋirena Iesusa Lasarusmo ŋgogo niŋgikna kam ndoprina. Na an kɨdrɨkca mina mba garacri, Iesusa aindoprina, Lasarusa menacrinan.
Ainda moca Iesusa mandeaca minmo mbopca waracrina, na ma gaindopatna, “Lasarusa ma mamenacri.
Na aku toŋgorinanna aku an kɨdrɨkca manapa mba eacri. Anna aku nena moca lamŋirina. Na anna ndo nenmo moca ne rɨpacnandet. Aintik mandeaca aia man ndambuŋa taŋnandet.”
Na Iesusa aindopca maicatke, Tomas mana i ianna Didimus, ma ndo, Iesusna iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrmo gaindopatna, “Aria, aia muruŋa taŋca Iesusap Iudia tɨkca manap menacna.”
Aku ndo meikramtaɨra menacrinanna mac mo ŋgeŋgepna gargarap
Karica Iesusapa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra taŋga Betani auŋmo rambuŋairi, ma ainda waracrina, mina Lasarusmo mutoca muk inik ndeaca raia paur mamoat.
Na Betani auŋa ma Ierusalem auŋ aniacmo tawan ŋgoinna wanaiŋ.
Ainda moca Iudanaŋgepta meikramtaɨr wɨtta kɨpca Mataapa Maria mbaniŋap eacrina, te, maniŋa iro wetwet aŋgɨca ndoniŋna ndaŋna moca mba kadmaiitndai.
Ri, Mata ma waracrinanna, Iesusa taup ndiŋ nakɨpri, aintik ma ndona lapnameac Mariamo tɨkcarica ma taup ndiŋa taŋca manmo ndauprikina.
Karica ma manmo gaindopatna, “Kacoot u gan ndeac co, aukna ndaŋa mba menac mbe.
Na mandeac aku malamŋiri, u Raraŋ Aetaniacmo, reac ianna mbendei te, ma unmo neaŋnandet.”
Ri, Iesusa manmo gaindopatna, “Una ndaŋa ma mac ŋgepnandet.”
Na Mata manmo aindopatna, “Aku lamŋirena, ma gan tiacarpaikna mamaina ra ma mac ŋgepnande, na an mɨnna gan tiacarpaikna meikramtaɨra muruŋa mac ŋgepnandet.”
Ainda moca ma manmo gaindoprina, “Mac nda ŋgeŋgepca aku ndo. Na eteacna watta aku ndo. Na mandaia aukmo rɨpac te, na ma menac te, ma eacraŋnandet.
Na meikramtaɨra muruŋa menac ŋgocora, aukmo rɨpacrenan, mina mba menacitndai. Mina iarwar ndeacraŋnandet. Na u anna rɨpacri ki, co wanaiŋ?”
Ri, Mata Iesusmo gaindopatna, “Ore Kacoot. Aku rɨpacrina, u Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc. Na u an ramootta Raraŋ Aetaniaca babuca mbagɨrica kɨpca aimo mac nda aŋgɨna ramoot.”
Iesusa Lasarusna kadmaica ma aerina
Na Mata aindopacarica ma taŋga ndona lapnameac Mariana maacat. Ri, ma mana koarmo laŋanna gaindopatna, “Ririptia kɨpca maeacreke, na ma una moca digirena.”
Ainda moca Maria an kam mbaraca ma tawi ŋgoin naŋgepca Iesus mbatna mataŋgat.
Na Iesusa ma auŋmo mba larureke. Ma an taupca Mata manmo watrinanna, ma an ndeacrena.

Na an Iudanaŋgepca Mariaap kadmaica eacrenan, mina watrinanna, ma ŋgepca tawi ŋgoinna kac tɨkcarica laruri, mitoco ŋgepca laruca maraŋgaiat. Na mina gaind ndamŋirina, moca ma taŋca mukca tɨkca ae nari.
Ainda moca Maria ma taŋca Iesus eacrena taup ndaruca, ma manmo watca, mana kɨtɨmma ma ndona tutupniŋmo rɨmbɨtca manmo gaindopatna, “Kacoot, u gan ndeac co, aukna ndaŋa ma mba menac mbe.”
Ri, Iesusa wattatnanna Mariaapa Iudana meikramtaɨra aerena, na ma kakadmai ŋgoin mamoat.
Na ma mimo madigiat, “Waɨrmo ne tenna mutocrina?” Ri, mina manmo nda rutica gaindopatna, “Kacoot, u kɨpca ndo wat.”
Ri, Iesusa anduna maaeat.
Na Iudana meikramtaɨra aindopatna, “Ne wat, ma Lasarusna toŋtoŋ aniac ŋgoin tik ma aerena.”
Na mina ndeida aindopatna, “Ma lamnik ŋgorikmo, moa laŋa morenan, na kaica ma Lasarusmo otac ŋgocor?”
Iesusa Lasarusmo mac moa ŋgepatna
Na Iesusa ma kakadmai aniacap maeacreke. Ainda moca ma muk ndambuŋa taŋrina, na an mukca mina wautmo aua iaca waut aniac mbuŋa mana tɨŋmo mboracrena.
Karica ma ramtaɨrmo mbopca, mina wautmo rukica taŋ te, tɨŋa gootna. Ri, Mata gaindopatna, “Kacoot, u lamŋirena Lasarusa ma menaca raia paur mamoat, na waɨra ma iŋpairapacnandet.”
Ri, ma minmo aindopatna, “Aku nenmo mboprinan, ne rɨpac te, ne Raraŋ Aetaniacna gargarapa i aniacmo watnandet.”
Ainda moca mina wautmo rukica taŋga roumbmbaia tɨkri, Iesusa tamuŋna auŋa raia watca ma mambendeiat, na ma aindopatna, “Ate, aku unmo toŋtoŋ ŋgoin, u aukna mbembendeimo mawaracri.
Na aku lamŋirena, u memetmbaca aukna mbembendeiarmo, u waracrena. Na aku aindop te, gan meikramtaɨra rɨpacnandet, u aukmo mbagɨrica aku kɨprina.”
Karica ma mbendeia maiatke, ma kam keca gaindopatna, “Lasarus, u laru!”

Na an menacrina ramootta malaruat. Na mana orapa para mina raraŋit budir puŋga tamairina, na mana inpaŋan tocmo raraŋit mbuŋa tamairina. Karica Iesusa meikramtaɨrmo gaindopatna, “Mana tikna raraŋitmo pɨarca ma taŋna.”
Ramtaɨr paŋainda Iesusmo mo menacna kamb leacatna
Ainda moca an Iudanaŋgepta ramtaɨr wɨt aniaca Mariaap kɨpca kakadmaica morinanna, mina an reaca Iesusa moatnanna watca mina manmo marɨpacat.
Ri, mina ndeida ŋgepca taŋca Parisiarmo an man morina reacna kam ndoprina.
Ainda moca taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa Parisiara mina ninik waŋgorta ramtaɨrmo aca kɨpca mina minmo gaindoprina, “Aia tida moit? Gan ramootta ma ŋgagatrac wɨt aniaca morenan.
Na aia manmo wattacarica ma an tɨp kirara moraŋ te, meikramtaɨra muruŋcamiŋa manmo rɨpacnandet. Te, Romnaŋgepca kɨpca aina Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kacapa aina barna wiwitna meikramtaɨrmo, mo topnande.”
Na mina rɨkna ramoot ianna mana ia Kaiapas, na an mɨnna ma taup ndamoot paŋan aniac ndeacri, na ma minmo gaindopatna, “Ne iroar kocor koind ki?
Aintik nen opotacna iro landamŋiap kocor ki? Na anna laŋ, ramoot kabea ndo meikramtaɨr wɨtna taup aŋgɨca menac te, aina barna wiwitna meikramtaɨra mba topitndait.”
Na Kaiapas ma ndona iro mbuŋa an kambmo mba moatke, wanaiŋ. An mɨnna ma taup ndamoot paŋan aniac ndeacri, ma an rambna kambmo moca Iesusa menac te, Iudanaŋgepta meikramtaɨrmo otacna.

Ainda moca Iesusa menacatnanna, ma Iudanaŋgepta meikramtaɨr tiŋgikmo mba otacnanna. Wanaiŋ. Ma menacrinanna, ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna mombonikca tamtam ndeacrenanmo, aŋgɨca tumbunna tɨkca mina wiwit kabe ndarunan.
Ri, an ra ŋgoin mbuŋa, ramtaɨr paŋainda kamb leaca taupembta koreca, manmo mo menacna.

Ainda moca Iesusa Iudanaŋgepta raekmo mba mac larua taŋri. Aintik ma an auŋ tɨkcarica ma meikramtaɨr kocorta taupna auŋ ianna mana ia Epiraim mataŋgat, na ma ndona iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrap, an ndeacrina.
Na an Pasowana Ra ma kɨpca marambuŋairi. Ainda moca auŋembta meikramtaɨra Ierusalem auŋ aniaca taŋca ndorimo Raraŋ Aetaniacna lamnɨac ŋgoutmo, mo ratna moca mataŋgat.
Ri, mina Iesusna ŋgorerina. Na mina Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kacna wuocna inikca wɨtɨkca ndorita rɨkmo aindoprina, “Ne tit ndamŋire? Ma an mbembendeina ra aniaca watna kɨpit ki, co wanaiŋ?”
Na taup ndamtaɨr paŋaindapa Parisiara mina meikramtaɨrmo mambopat, mandaia lamŋi te, Iesusa ten ndeac te, ma minmo kam landamŋi neaŋ te, mina manmo utiŋa kac ŋgoreaca tɨknandet.
